title: Super tour!
text: Lilya showed me absolutely different shops and we tried delicious tapas. I bought perfume in a gorgeous shop, some vintage details for my friends and typical sweets for a family. I highly recommend this tour for everybody who comes to Barcelona.
author: Dmitry_V

title: Perfect day 1 experience
text: My mum and I took this walking tour day 1 in Barcelona. It was a fantastic way to learn about the local culture and get the lay of the land. We also went to a couple lovely local shops where the artists, designers and creators produce their goods. Fantastic tour with an excellent guide, Lillia was a joy!
author: Gina_F
